name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)

fee.note: Published exam-only price; page includes two exam attempts and two simulator attempts. Promotions and checkout were not tested.

exam.format: Two-hour command-line performance exam with no formal prerequisites; container/microservice working knowledge is assumed.

scope: Designing, building and deploying cloud-native applications on Kubernetes, tested at the command line.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
domains_note: Weights from the Linux Foundation certification page, 'Domains & Competencies' section, read 2026-11-03.
